name: Pig profile
duplicates: The old Figma draws pig detail in the 猪只列表 file as well as inside Inspection.

entryPoints.label: Tap a pig in the walk
From a task: a sow in the Farrowing room list opens her record (inside Farrowing's sow drawer)
entryPoints.control: The first sow row, then Profile

entryPoints.label: From a task: Actions on a sow opens the Actions sheet with Farrowing's rows added
entryPoints.control: The first sow row, then Actions

entryPoints.label: From the pig list (the pig list itself is a placeholder feature written elsewhere, so no source screen exists yet)
entryPoints.control: A pig row in the list

notes.purpose: Read one pig on the spot: what needs attention, what to do next, who she is, how she is fed, and where to read more. The populated example is sow 000267 (Duroc, parity 2, Thin · Monitor).
states: Needs-attention rows present or absent.
Pig dead (stage "Sow died"): Actions offers a note only.
Embedded in Farrowing: the same sheet opens inside the sow drawer with Farrowing's production actions added.

elements.name: Header · title
elements.logic: The pig's ear tag.

elements.name: Header · scope
elements.logic: Unit name, pen id and the stage summary (same text as the walk row).

elements.name: Needs-attention rows
elements.logic: One row per condition whose care is Monitor, Treat in place or Move to hospital pen: type word "Health", the condition, then care (omitted when None) and "Day N". Row colour follows the care level. Absent when there is none.

elements.name: Pig note row
elements.logic: Only when the pig has a note (p.note); opens the pig log.

elements.name: Last treatment
elements.shows: Last treatment · medicine name · dose unit · method
elements.logic: Only when a treatment was recorded for the pig (not in the sample pigs until one is recorded).

elements.name: Current tasks
elements.shows: Current tasks · 1 task · Pregnancy check · Tomorrow · 13 Sep · Batch 20 · Production
elements.logic: Horizontal rail of task cards (see pig-profile.tasks). Absent when the pig has no task.

elements.name: General details · Age
elements.logic: The pig's age field, else days since the birth date; "—" if neither.

elements.name: General details · Type · Breed
elements.logic: Animal type: registry type, else the type field, else "Sow" if the pig has a parity, else its stage. Breed from the registry.

elements.name: General details · Batch
elements.logic: The pig's production batch id.

elements.name: General details · Weight · Temperature
elements.logic: Last recorded value with the age of the reading ("Today", "1 day ago", "N days ago", "Date unknown").

elements.name: General details · On farm
elements.logic: From the registry; "—" when unknown.

elements.name: General details · Health
elements.logic: Ongoing conditions only (care "No action needed"), each a tag with "N days" that opens the condition; "—" when none. Needs-attention conditions are in the rows above instead.

elements.name: Type block
elements.shows: Sow cycle / Gilt breeding / Boar breeding / Piglet growth / Growth
elements.logic: Heading and facts follow the animal type: sow Last service, Expected farrowing, Backfat, Teat count, Next task, Parity; gilt not gestating First heat, Next heat; boar Last service, Breeding number; piglet Birth weight, Weaning date, Dam, Weaning weight; grower/finisher/weaner Entry weight, Entry date.

elements.name: Type block · Last service
elements.logic: Date as recorded plus days before the walk date (12 Sep 2026).

elements.name: Type block · Expected farrowing
elements.logic: Text is "Today", "In N days" ahead, or "N days past expected".

elements.name: Type block · Next task
elements.logic: Next task of the pig's batch with timing: "Today", "In N days" ahead, "N days overdue" behind.

elements.name: Feeding block
elements.shows: Feeding · View plan · Gestation 1 · Included in pen allocation · 2.6 kg/day · Feed +10% Thin · mild
elements.logic: Formula, delivery context, the pig's allowance and its feed tags with their reason. "No feeding plan recorded" for a pen with unknown mode.

elements.name: Pig record links
elements.logic: Three rows with a one-line description each.

elements.name: Footer
elements.logic: Back returns to where the pig was opened; Actions opens the pig's Actions sheet.

controls.control: A needs-attention row or an ongoing health tag

controls.does: opens the Actions sheet for this pig

edge: A pig in no batch shows no Next task value and a dash for Batch.
The type block is absent for types it does not know.
rules: Human-entered records lead; derived plans and stable facts stay in reading sections (comment in the code).
Reading links keep a 44 px tap height and return to the correct pig record (BLIND-REVIEW).
issues: The same facts are repeated on one sheet: Pregnancy check appears as a task card ("Tomorrow · 13 Sep · Batch 20") and as Next task ("In 1 day"); Batch 20 appears in the task card and in General details; the stage and days appear in the header and the sow cycle ("Gestation · 42 days" and "Last service 42 days ago").
Six blocks (attention, tasks, general details, type block, feeding, record links) on one sheet; a worker standing at a pen needs the care and the next action first, not breed, on-farm and teat count.
Age is in days for a sow ("966 days"), which a farmer cannot read at a glance.
Weight and Temperature show the value in plain text; a temperature of 39.5 C gets no mark beside a Fever finding.
Type word appears three times: General details "Type", the block title "Sow cycle", and the stage.
Dashes: every empty field is drawn as a row with "—" (sample pigs with partial data show many), instead of leaving the row out.

screens.name: Pig record · partial
screens.zh: 猪只详情 · 部分信息

notes.purpose: How the record reads when the registry is thin: sow 000254 has breed, weight, age, teats but no service date, no expected farrowing and no backfat.
states: Some fields filled, some "—".

elements.name: Sow cycle · Last service · Expected farrowing · Backfat
elements.logic: Empty values draw the dash and the row stays; the age note beside a value is dropped.

elements.name: General details · Health
elements.logic: No conditions recorded.

elements.name: Weight
elements.logic: Reading age shown beside the value.

controls.control: A needs-attention row or an ongoing health tag

controls.does: opens the Actions sheet for this pig

edge: The Feeding and Next task blocks are unaffected by missing registry data.
rules: An empty section is absent, never rendered as "none" - applied to production averages but not to these rows.
issues: Missing facts are shown as dashes in a fixed grid; four dashes in a row (service, farrowing, backfat, and Health) read as a broken page.

notes.purpose: The worst case: sow 000306 has only type and on-farm in the registry, but real work: two open conditions, a vaccination due today, a station-fed plan.
states: Header "Gestation · —" (no stage start).
Needs-attention rows for Fever (Treat in place · Day 2) and Poor appetite (Monitor · Day 2).
Two tasks.

elements.name: General details
elements.logic: All registry facts empty.

elements.name: Sow cycle
elements.shows: Last service — · Expected farrowing — · Backfat — · Teat count — · Parity 5
elements.logic: Parity is held on the pig, so it shows.

elements.name: Feeding
elements.logic: Station-fed pen.

controls.control: A needs-attention row or an ongoing health tag

controls.does: opens the Actions sheet for this pig

edge: The preset is named for empty fields, yet the pig carries open work; that work is shown in full while the facts are blank.
issues: The same facts are repeated on one sheet: Pregnancy check appears as a task card ("Tomorrow · 13 Sep · Batch 20") and as Next task ("In 1 day"); Batch 20 appears in the task card and in General details; the stage and days appear in the header and the sow cycle ("Gestation · 42 days" and "Last service 42 days ago").
The worker's view is dominated by the grid of dashes; the two attention rows and two tasks are the only useful content and they sit above it.
Header "Gestation · —" has a dash where the stage days should be.

screens.name: Pig record · current tasks
screens.zh: 猪只详情 · 当前任务

notes.purpose: Show that one pig can have several tasks at once and how each opens. Sow 000254 has a Vaccination (Health, due today) and her batch's Pregnancy check (Production, tomorrow).
states: One or more cards; a card may be marked active (in progress) or due (today).
No task: the whole section is absent.

elements.name: Heading
elements.logic: Count with singular/plural.

elements.name: Task card · icon
elements.logic: Syringe for vaccination or a Vaccination title, chart for Production type, plus for others.

elements.name: Task card · title and line
elements.logic: Status then summary, joined with " · ". Batch tasks use summary "Batch 20" and the status "In progress" or the next date.

elements.name: Task card · type
elements.logic: Type chip from the task.

elements.name: Order
elements.logic: Sorted: In progress, then Due today, then Tomorrow, then the rest.

elements.name: Sources
elements.shows: host tasks, pig tasks, batch task
elements.logic: Tasks from Farrowing's drawer, the pig's own list and the batch (current or next task); de-duplicated by id or title; tasks completed in this session are removed.

controls.does: opens Record vaccination (vaccine list only) which completes the task on Save
opens the Farrowing prototype (or the drawer's task when embedded)

edge: Only tasks of the pig's own batch pigs: a task with a pigIds list shows only to those pigs.
rules: "Current task, including Farrowing: hidden in bulk actions" (ASTRA-BULK-ACTIONS) - tasks are single-pig.
issues: The same tasks are listed again in the Actions sheet (Production cluster, and Health) - two doors to one task.
A task's own type word (Health / Production) sits beside the Actions groups called Health and Production; same names, different meaning (task type vs action group).

notes.purpose: A sow's batch history: averages over finished batches and one row per batch, current first. The example is sow 000281.
states: Averages shown only when at least one batch is completed; otherwise the section is absent.
Metric set follows the animal type.
No batch records: "No batch records."

elements.name: Title · scope
elements.logic: Page title; ear tag, unit, pen.

elements.name: Averages · heading
elements.logic: Count of completed batches.

elements.name: Averages · Born alive
elements.logic: Mean of bornAlive over completed batches, one decimal (14 and 12).

elements.name: Averages · Weaned
elements.logic: Mean of weaned (13 and 11).

elements.name: Averages · Weaning wt.
elements.logic: Total weaning litter weight divided by total weaned piglets over batches that have both; kg per piglet.

elements.name: Averages for other types
elements.shows: Boar: Services / batch; others: Entry weight, Exit weight
elements.logic: Sow and gilt use the litter metrics.

elements.name: Batch row · current
elements.logic: The current batch, built from the pig's batch id with the stage summary; tag "Current".

elements.name: Batch row · finished
elements.logic: Weaned count, weaning weight per piglet, finish date ("Date unknown" if none), rating if any. Boar: "N services"; others "N kg at finish".

edge: A weaning weight of a batch with zero weaned piglets is ignored.
rules: Design law: an empty section is absent, never rendered as "none" (comment in productionOverview).
issues: The pig's lifetime figures (litters, born total, farrowing rate, weaning rate, farrowing interval, non-productive days) are seeded on the pig but not drawn here.
The second line of each finished batch repeats "6.6 kg" which the Averages block gives as an average.

notes.purpose: One finished or current batch of the pig. How to reach it: a batch row on Production stats.
states: Current: "Current batch" and This cycle (Last service, Expected farrowing; others show Type, Age).
Finished: Results, Finish weaning, author and finish date, optional note.
Record not found: "Record unavailable."

elements.name: Title · scope
elements.logic: In progress for the current batch.

elements.name: Results
elements.shows: Born alive 14 · Stillborn 1 · Weaned 13 · Weaning weight 6.6 kg/pig
elements.logic: Weaning weight = litter weight / weaned.

elements.name: Finish weaning
elements.shows: Farrowed 10 Jun 2026 · Weaned 8 Jul 2026 · Parity · Rating · Sow weight · Backfat
elements.logic: Dashes for missing values. For boars and others the block is "Finish record" with Finished and Rating.

elements.name: Author line
elements.logic: Finish date and who recorded.

elements.name: Note
elements.logic: Only when the batch record holds a note.

issues: "Finish weaning" is the title for sows only; the name for a boar block is "Finish record".

notes.purpose: Where the pig came from and the identities it carries. How to reach it: Origin on the pig record.
states: Facts present or "—"; the disclosure "Other identities N" lists more identities, or reads "Other identities —" when none.

elements.name: Origin & dates
elements.shows: Entry type, Birth date, Arrival date, First heat, Birth farm, Genetic line, Dam, Sire
elements.logic: Fixed set of eight rows; dash when missing.

elements.name: Identity records
elements.shows: Current ear tag, Breeding number, Other ear tag
elements.logic: The ear tag is the pig's id.

elements.name: Other identities
elements.logic: Collapsible list of type and value.

issues: Entire page is read-only; a worker who finds a wrong ear tag or breed cannot fix it here.

notes.purpose: Everything recorded on this pig, filterable. How to reach it: Log on the pig record, or the Note row.
states: All activity or one category (Production, Health, Movement, Feed, Measurements, Notes); all dates or a preset or custom range; empty or no match.

elements.name: Filter bar
elements.shows: All activity · All dates · 5 entries · Newest first
elements.logic: Same bar as the pen log; no Equipment category for pigs.

elements.name: Entry
elements.shows: Health · Thin · Body condition · Day 12 · Monitor · Before this walk · Author not supplied
elements.logic: Category tag, title, note, date and time, author. Seeded entries without a date read "Before this walk"; they stay at the end and pass no date filter.

elements.name: Entry · today
elements.logic: Entries saved in the session are stamped Today 09:41.

edge: Corrections and entered-in-error findings stay in the log.
issues: "Author not supplied" and "Start date and author not supplied" appear on seeded entries; real records would always have both.
The name changes: Log (link), Pig log (title).

notes.purpose: Everything a worker can do to one pig, in three groups: Production, Health, General. How to reach it: Actions on the pig record; in Farrowing, Actions on a sow. The same sheet opens for several pigs (inspection.actions).
states: Production group: only for one pig, and only the rows that fit her stage and tasks.
Unavailable rows move to "Unavailable actions (N)" with the reason.
Dead sow: Production and Health empty, only a note.

Opened from Farrowing (embedded): rows added by Farrowing are mixed in (piglet processing, piglet deaths, reconcile count, foster, edit litter, sow death, remove from batch, mark not in pig, transfer).

elements.name: Title · scope
elements.logic: Ear tag and pen.

elements.name: Production · task cluster
elements.shows: Pregnancy check → row "Pregnancy check · Tomorrow · 13 Sep · Batch 20"
elements.logic: One cluster per production scope found among her tasks and her stage (Farrowing, Piglet processing, Pregnancy check, Gestation, Breeding, Lactation, Growth, Shared); the cluster heading and the single row carry the same word.

elements.name: Production · Record miscarriage
elements.logic: Offered when the stage reads gestating, in heat or breeding.

elements.name: Production · Batch membership
elements.shows: Batch 20 · move or remove / Add this pig to a batch
elements.logic: Always listed; unavailable ("No production batches are available.") when she is in no batch and no other batch exists.

elements.name: Health group
elements.shows: Disease or symptom · Record treatment · Resolve conditions · Care instructions
elements.logic: Resolve and Care appear only if she has a condition; otherwise they are listed as unavailable with the reason. Edit conditions is bulk only.

elements.name: General group
elements.shows: Add a note · Measurements & condition · Adjust feed
elements.logic: Adjust feed is absent (unavailable with reason) for ad-lib, dead or no-plan pigs.

elements.name: Footer tabs
elements.logic: Jump to a group; the active tab follows scroll position.

elements.name: Unavailable actions (N)
elements.logic: Count of blocked rows; opens the list.

controls.does: opens the outcome form (or Farrowing for farrowing and piglet processing)

controls.control: Disease or symptom · Record treatment · Resolve conditions · Care instructions

edge: For a dead sow every row is unavailable except Add a note.
Remove from batch, Move to another farrowing batch and Batch membership overlap: the Farrowing versions are hidden when this sheet's own Batch membership row exists.
Mark not in pig, Remove from batch and Transfer sow render only inside Farrowing's sow drawer (they need the host's data and are not reachable standalone).
rules: Production actions exist only for one pig (ASTRA-BULK-ACTIONS).
A blocked pig is listed with the reason, never dropped silently (section rule).
Farrowing opens the shared health flows rather than duplicating them (HEALTH-MANAGEMENT).
issues: The cluster heading repeats the row title ("Pregnancy check" over "Pregnancy check") when a cluster holds one row.
The task appears here, in Current tasks on the record, and as Next task: three places for one task.
Production holds clusters named after tasks or stages (Gestation, Shared) with one row each; the grouping adds a heading per row.
Body condition is under General (Measurements & condition) but creates a health finding.
Farrowing's own row "Add note / Edit note" (a marker, named Add marker in MARKERS.md) and this sheet's "Add a note" are the same idea; when the Farrowing row exists this sheet hides its own.

notes.purpose: Finish or defer a production task from the pig. How to reach it: a Production task card on the record, or the task row in Actions.
states: Pregnancy check: Pregnant · Not in pig · Recheck later.
Any other task: Complete task · Follow up.
Save disabled until an outcome is chosen.

elements.name: Title · scope
elements.logic: Task title, ear tag, batch.

elements.name: Outcome choices
elements.shows: Pregnant - Keep in the current gestation batch; Not in pig - Close this task and return the sow to rebreed watch; Recheck later - Keep the task open for another check
elements.logic: Selected one shows a check mark.

elements.name: Note · optional
elements.shows: Add useful context for the next person
elements.logic: Free text.

elements.name: Save
elements.logic: Label turns to "Save follow-up" for Recheck later and Follow up.

controls.does: completes the task (not for recheck/follow-up); Not in pig removes her from the batch and sets her Off production / Open; returns to the pig record

edge: "Not in pig" changes the sow's stage and batch with no confirmation.
rules: Not in pig: "records a production outcome, removes the sow from this batch, and returns her to rebreed watch" (code text).
issues: Not in pig is one tap in a list of three equal choices; a mis-tap changes batch and stage with no confirmation or undo.
The record page of a non-pregnancy task uses a generic "Complete task / Follow up" pair that tells the worker nothing about what was done.

notes.purpose: Record a pregnancy loss as a production outcome. How to reach it: Actions, Production, Record miscarriage.
states: Reason empty: Save disabled.

elements.name: Warning
elements.shows: This sow will be removed from the batch. Saved records are kept.
elements.logic: Fixed.

elements.name: Reason
elements.logic: Free text, required.

elements.name: Save
elements.logic: Removes her from the batch, sets Off production / Open, adds "Miscarriage recorded" (Production) and returns to the pig record.

edge: Not offered once another outcome is recorded in Farrowing; this sheet does not check for an existing outcome (unclear: whether it should).
rules: MISCARRIAGE.md: reason, batch removal consequence, history, unavailable states for dead sows.
issues: Reason is a free text box; the production-task outcome "Not in pig" lists evidence choices instead - two forms for a similar loss.

notes.purpose: Put the pig into a batch, move her to another, or remove her. How to reach it: Actions, Production, Batch membership.
states: In a batch: card "Current batch · Batch 20 · Gestating · 5 pigs", choices of other batches and "Remove from batch".
In no batch: "No batch - This pig is not assigned to a production batch." and "Add to batch".
No batch to choose: "No production batches are available."

elements.name: Current batch card
elements.logic: Stage and member count.

elements.name: Picker
elements.logic: Options "Batch N · stage" for the other batches and "Remove from batch".

elements.name: Note
elements.logic: Optional.

elements.name: Save
elements.shows: Move pig / Add to batch / Remove from batch
elements.logic: Label follows the choice; disabled until one is chosen. Moving also sets the pig's stage to the new batch's stage.

controls.does: saves and returns to the pig record

edge: Moving a pig overwrites her stage with the batch stage.
issues: A stage change as a side effect of "Move pig" is not stated on the form.

notes.purpose: Pick which reading to record. How to reach it: Actions, General, Measurements & condition.
states: One pig: Record body condition (hidden for an ad-lib pig), Record weight, Record temperature, Record backfat (sows and gilts only).
Several pigs: body condition, weight (a separate value for each), backfat; no temperature.

elements.name: Body condition row
elements.logic: Opens the body-condition form.

elements.name: Weight row
elements.shows: Weight in kg / A separate value for each pig
elements.logic: Text follows single or bulk.

elements.name: Temperature row
elements.logic: One pig only.

elements.name: Backfat row
elements.logic: Only if the pig is a sow or gilt.

rules: Weight, backfat and temperature take one value per pig (section rule).
issues: A menu with three or four rows between the Actions sheet and the form: one extra tap for each reading.

screens.name: Record weight, temperature or backfat
screens.zh: 记录体重 / 体温 / 背膘

notes.purpose: Enter one reading for one pig, or one per pig for several. How to reach it: Measurements & condition, then the reading.
states: One pig: a number field with the unit, "Last recorded: 192 kg · 3 days ago", optional note.
Several pigs: scrolling list "Current → New · kg", a row per pig; blank rows stay unchanged.
A value that is not above 0 marks the row "Enter a value above 0" and blocks the save.
Backfat: boars and piglets rows read "Sows and gilts only".

elements.name: Field
elements.logic: Number, decimal; unit follows the reading (kg, °C, mm).

elements.name: Last recorded
elements.logic: Previous value and age of the reading; shown for one pig only.

elements.name: Row preview
elements.logic: Current to new value.

elements.name: Save
elements.logic: N = rows that changed; disabled until at least one row changed and none has an error.

controls.does: writes the readings and a log entry per pig, clears the selection and returns to the walk list

rules: Blank rows stay unchanged; invalid entered readings block the whole save (ASTRA-BULK-ACTIONS).
issues: After saving a reading the sheet drops back to the walk list, not to the pig record the worker came from (the production task, miscarriage and batch forms do return to the record).
Any value above 0 saves: there is no upper bound or plausibility check on weight, temperature or backfat.
A saved temperature has no normal range or flag.

notes.purpose: Record a pig as Thin or Over-conditioned. How to reach it: Measurements & condition, Record body condition.
states: Choose condition: Thin or Over-conditioned; note says "Records condition. Feed stays unchanged."
Several pigs: preview "— → Thin"; rows already at that condition stay unchanged.

elements.name: Condition
elements.logic: Two options only.

elements.name: Row preview
elements.logic: Current body-condition finding name, or "—".

elements.name: Save
elements.logic: On Save a Body condition finding is added with care Monitor (or its name replaced); the log reads "... · feed unchanged".

controls.does: saves, clears the selection and returns to the walk list

edge: Earlier versions linked the condition band to an automatic feed adjustment; this form does not (the band form is in the code but not opened).
rules: Body condition records the finding only; feed changes are made in Adjust feed.
issues: A body condition becomes a health finding with Monitor care at once, so it appears as "needs attention" on the walk; the form does not say so.

notes.purpose: Leave a note on a pig (or the same note on several). How to reach it: Actions, General, Add a note.
states: One pig: a text area. Several pigs: the same note is recorded separately for each included pig.

elements.name: Note
elements.logic: Free text.

elements.name: Save
elements.logic: Disabled while empty. The note becomes the pig's note, shown as a "Note" row on the record, replacing any earlier note.

controls.does: saves, clears the selection and returns to the walk list

rules: The same note is recorded separately for each pig (ASTRA-BULK-ACTIONS).
issues: A new note overwrites the old one on the pig (the log keeps both); the screen does not say so.

notes.purpose: Show every blocked action with its reason. How to reach it: "Unavailable actions (N)" at the end of the Actions sheet.
states: Grouped Production, Health, General; every row disabled with the reason as its sub-line.

elements.name: Row
elements.shows: Resolve conditions · No open conditions to resolve.
elements.logic: Title and the reason.

elements.name: Reasons in the code
elements.shows: No open conditions to resolve. · Record a health finding first. · Pig has died · Ad-lib feeding has no fixed daily allowance · No feeding plan recorded · No production batches are available. · Ad-lib pigs do not have an individual ration.
elements.logic: Fixed strings by cause.

rules: A blocked action is listed with the reason, never dropped silently.
issues: The list sits one tap behind the Actions sheet, and for most pigs holds one or two rows; showing the reason on the row inside Actions (disabled) would avoid the extra page.
